name: What Grows on Nothing

levels.entry: The island top carries grass, cushion-plant and a stand of mangrove at the edge.
The mangrove roots run out past the rock and hold it. Where they have died back the edge has gone with them.
Moss on the ore grows toward iron. A nail laid on a mat of it is furred over in a season.
The lotus in the climbing water is warm to the hand and stays warm after it is picked, which no other flower here does.

notes: Aravali. Four rungs rather than five: this one answers.
